trigger: Triage and fix the next confirmed regression in a 12-issue GitHub queue.

goal.objective: Fix issue #184, where an empty label filter returns every issue.
acceptance_criteria: An empty label filter returns no filtered results.
out_of_scope: Opening or merging a pull request
constraints: Do not modify unrelated queue items

assumptions: The issue's empty-filter example represents intended behavior
authority_limits: Local changes and tests only; no GitHub writes

changes_made: Filter now returns an empty result for an empty label selection
execution.retry_budget: One revision after the initial patch

checks.name: Focused filter test suite
checks.evidence: All 18 filter tests passed, including the new empty-selection regression case.

decision.reason: Issue #184 is fixed locally and all required checks pass.
decision.stop_condition_met: The current queue item meets its acceptance criteria; selecting another issue requires a new work unit.
decision.next_action: Request authority before opening a pull request, or select the next queue item in a separate run.

human_checkpoint.recommendation: Review the local patch before authorizing a pull request.
